Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
We were playing last night and this question came up:

If an ally is using an equipment or card which isn't restricted to vampires (e.g. it reads minion) but the action has a blood cost, can the ally pay the cost in its life?

Example card:

Codex of the Edenic Groundskeepers
Type: Equipment
Cost: 1 pool
Unique equipment.
This minion gets -2 stealth when bleeding. This minion may bleed as a  action that costs 1 blood; this action gets +3 bleed if the target Methuselah doesn't control a ready untapped minion.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Vlad
Messages.Body:
Ok for this one, but I believe that was an omission in the Rafastio Ghoul card text...

But the question is the same with the Herald of Topheth...

Herald of Topheth [BL:R2]
Cardtype: Ally
Clan: Baali
Cost: 3 pool
Demon with 5 life. 3 strength, 1 bleed, flight [FLIGHT].
The Herald may enter combat with a ready minion controlled by another Methuselah as a  action. The Herald may play cards requiring basic Daimoinon [dai], Potence [pot] and/or Presence  as a vampire with a capacity of 5. Any cost in blood is paid with his life. If a card would give him blood, give him life instead. If the Herald has less than 5 life during your untap phase, add 1 life. During your influence phase, burn 1 pool or burn the Herald.

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
> Vlad wrote:
> Ok for this one, but I believe that was an omission in the Rafastio Ghoul card text...
>
> But the question is the same with the Herald of Topheth...
>
And so is the answer.

If an ally can play a specific subset of cards 'as a vampire', then they can play that specific subset of cards and pay life where blood is required.

All other cards that require blood cannot be played by that ally.
